title: Sure Petcare Flap Event Curfew Breaches Leaderboard
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder cam detections, plant/soil sensors (`plant:sensor`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=surepetcare:flap curfew_breaches=*
| stats sum(curfew_breaches) as total_value, avg(curfew_breaches) as avg_value by pet_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks pet values by total and average curfew breaches across Sure Petcare flap event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `curfew_breaches` values for each Sure Petcare flap event event and review total and average curfew breaches by pet.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total curfew breaches.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews which pet shows the biggest curfew breaches numbers in your Sure Petcare flap event data.
